title: iris nudicaulis subsp. fieberi
intro: Iris nudicaulis subsp. fieberi, commonly known as the Alpine Iris, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the genus Iris. It is native to Central and Eastern Europe, and has been used in traditional medicine for its therapeutic properties. The Alpine Iris is rich in bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of the Alpine Iris include wound healing, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, making it a valuable plant for the treatment of various health conditions.
